summary: Completed testing of Pengurus Rekap (income recap) feature - all backend APIs and frontend UI working correctly
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/pengurus-rekap (admin) - returns correct structure with year, rows, months, total
Backend: GET /api/pengurus-rekap (operator) - correctly returns 403 Forbidden
Backend: POST /api/pengurus-excavator with tarif_sewa_per_jam - creates and persists tarif
Backend: PATCH /api/pengurus-excavator - updates tarif_sewa_per_jam correctly
Backend: POST /api/units with tarif_sewa_per_jam - creates and persists unit tarif
Backend: PATCH /api/units - updates tarif_sewa_per_jam correctly
Backend: Calculation logic - TEST Pak Rudi shows 24 jam, Rp 8.400.000 pendapatan, Rp 4.005.000 bersih (correct)
Frontend: Admin sees rekap section on /pengurus page
Frontend: Year selector (rekap-pengurus-year) works correctly
Frontend: Stat cards display correctly - Total Pendapatan (Rp 8.400.000), Pengeluaran (Rp 4.395.000), Bersih (Rp 4.005.000), Jam (24)
Frontend: View toggles work - pendapatan, pengeluaran, bersih, jam
Frontend: Rekap table (rekap-pengurus-table) renders with monthly columns
Frontend: Expandable rows work - TEST Pak Rudi row expands to show detail metrics
Frontend: Export buttons present - rekap-pengurus-excel and rekap-pengurus-pdf
Frontend: Tarif input field (input-pengurus-tarif) in Pengurus form works with currency formatting
Frontend: Tarif input field (input-unit-tarif) in Units form works with currency formatting
Frontend: Operator does NOT see rekap section (correct access control)
Regression: Pengurus CRUD still works
Regression: Monthly chart dialog (chart-pengurus-{id}) still works
Regression: Units CRUD still works
Regression: Finance page still works
